question: A bakery baked 172 loaves in each of its 3 ovens on Friday, and a small extra oven produced another 78 loaves. Every loaf was cut into 3 thick slices for the weekend brunch service, and 1681 of those slices were used for sandwiches. Each slice that was left over was topped with 7 olives and set out on the tasting table. Guests then ate 80 of the olives. The cafe has 24 tables. How many olives are still on the tasting table?

A school film club records all of its running times in minutes and converts them into hours only for the printed programme. The club came back from a trip with 164 minutes of footage, which was split equally between its 2 editors, Ben and Sara, so that each of them started with a share of the same length. Ben cut 76 minutes of shaky material out of his share. He then removed another 3 minutes of silence. Finally he added 70 minutes of interviews to what was left. How many minutes long is Ben's film now?

A chocolate workshop had 110 boxes in its store on Monday, and a delivery on Tuesday made the number of boxes 2 times as large. On Wednesday 168 boxes were shipped to a supermarket. Each box left in the store holds 7 packets, every packet holds 4 bars, and every bar snaps into 2 pieces. Kofi, who runs the workshop, keeps more boxes in store than his rival Amara does. How many pieces of chocolate are in the store?

On Monday morning a juice bar received 62 sacks of oranges, and each sack held 4 baskets. Every basket in those sacks held 3 oranges. By the afternoon a second delivery had doubled the number of oranges in the shop. That evening the owner divided all of the oranges equally among the 3 branches of her business. The next morning the manager of one branch packed that branch's oranges into 4 equal crates and sent a single crate to a school. How many oranges are in the crate that went to the school?

A community kitchen baked 228 bread rolls for a street party. 171 rolls were eaten during the afternoon. A neighbour brought 31 more rolls from her own oven, and a bakery donated 20 more. All of the rolls left on the table were packed equally into 3 boxes for the night shelter. Sofia carried more boxes out to the van than Marco did. How many rolls does one of those boxes hold?

Mrs Patel bought 19 tomato seedlings for her balcony. She gave 17 of them to the community garden. The 2 seedlings she kept were shared equally between 2 identical pots, and she watched only the pot on the left. By July the plant in that pot had grown 3 tomatoes. She picked 2 of them for a salad. The balcony gets 6 hours of sun a day. How many tomatoes are still on that plant?

A party shop had 105 packets of balloons on the shelf. 76 packets were bought for a wedding, and 2 more were ruined by a leak in the roof. Each packet still on the shelf contains 8 balloons, and the owner emptied them all into one bin. A supplier dropped 14 loose balloons into the same bin. A children's party then used 97 balloons from the bin. The shop has 3 other branches. How many balloons are left in the bin?

A coach company records every journey in minutes and only turns the totals into hours for its printed timetable. On Tuesday a driver waited 20 minutes at each of the 4 loading bays, and the office added those waits into one figure. That figure was split equally between the 2 drivers who shared the shift, and Ellie took her share. Ellie's own driving added 29 minutes to her share. A short cut on the way back saved her 1 minute. The company owns 15 coaches. How many minutes does Ellie's total come to?

A tiling firm records its weights in kilograms although its invoices are written in tonnes. On Monday morning each of the 9 racks in the yard held 96 tiles, and 176 of those tiles were found cracked and taken away before noon. Every tile that was left weighs 5 kilograms. In the afternoon 2287 kilograms of tiles were loaded onto a lorry and driven off. In the evening a supplier dropped off 7 kilograms of spare tiles. The rest was divided equally among 4 vans for the next morning, and Ravi drove one of them while his colleague Sanjay set off with a lighter load of his own. How many kilograms of tiles are in Ravi's van?

A cheese shop had 78 rounds of cheese in the cold room, and a farm delivered 37 more. All the rounds were shared equally among the shop's 5 counters, and Dario took charge of the counter by the window. He then carried 13 more rounds up from the cold room, and 26 rounds from his counter were sold during the day. Each round still on his counter is cut into 6 wedges for the evening tasting. A dozen candles are lit on that counter every evening. How many wedges will Dario's counter have?

A school print room measures paper in sheets but writes its orders in reams, converting one into the other by hand. On Monday 132 blank booklets were shared equally among the 3 printing machines. Each booklet that a machine received was printed with 9 pages. The finished pages were gathered and split equally into 3 delivery stacks. Every page in a single stack was then photocopied 8 times for the year group, and those copies were shared equally among the 3 form classes. Mr Hale handed out 194 copies to his own class, while Ms Ives kept a smaller set for hers. How many copies does Mr Hale still have?

On Monday morning a printing shop had 136 posters in each of its 8 storage tubes. During the morning a designer added 25 loose posters to the same pile. In the afternoon the whole pile was shared equally among the shop's 3 branches, and Julia took the share for the branch on Mill Road. That evening a client returned 74 posters to Mill Road. Julia sold more posters that week than her colleague Ben did, and the shop van holds 900 posters. How many posters are at the Mill Road branch?

Sara keeps her revision log in minutes, though her tutor prefers to talk about it in hours. On Monday morning the log stood at 67 minutes, and she added 30 minutes before breakfast. She then crossed off 32 minutes that she had written down twice by mistake. During the afternoon she added 39 minutes, then 68 minutes, and in the early evening another 48 minutes. Late that night she removed 33 minutes she had spent chatting rather than working. How many minutes does Sara's log show now?

A campsite records its water in litres although the tank gauge is still marked in gallons. On Monday morning each of the 7 cabins was issued 136 litres of water from the store. During the day a spare barrel added 27 litres to the campsite's supply. By the afternoon 769 litres had been used for showers and cooking. In the evening a tanker arrived and doubled the amount of water still on the site. How many litres of water are on the site now?

On Monday morning a music shop had 181 sheets of music in its rack, and a customer donated 5 more before lunch. In the afternoon the shop's copier doubled the number of sheets in the rack. That evening the owner replaced everything in the rack with 3 copies of each sheet that had been in it. On Tuesday 31 sheets were sold from the rack, and on Wednesday 10 new sheets were added to it. On Thursday evening 561 sheets were sent to a school choir. How many sheets of music are in the rack now?

A cycling club logs every ride in minutes and prints the season total in hours. Priya's log began the month at 64 minutes. She added 67 minutes on her first ride, 78 minutes on her second and 63 minutes on her third. The club then removed 94 minutes that had been entered twice by mistake. Her last ride of the month added 46 minutes. Priya's log is longer this month than her friend Noor's log. How many minutes does Priya's log show?

A repair shop notes its jobs in minutes and bills them in hours. On Monday Farid's job list stood at 123 minutes of work, and two new bookings added 63 minutes and then 36 minutes. During the week 215 minutes of that work were finished and crossed off. A customer then booked a job worth 50 minutes. Farid has more minutes booked than his colleague Yusuf does, and the shop has 4 work bays. How many minutes of work are on Farid's list?

A pottery studio had 64 blocks of clay in its store. 55 blocks were used up in a school workshop. Each block that remained was rolled into 9 small pots. A visiting artist then brought 57 finished pots to the store, and 78 pots were sold at the weekend market. The pots that were left were packed equally into 6 crates for a craft fair. The studio has 3 kilns. How many pots are in one of those crates?

Marcus grows strawberries in 7 polytunnels, and each tunnel produced 217 punnets this June. He sold 994 punnets at the farmers market. A second picking then made the number of punnets he still had 2 times as large. A neighbour handed him 30 punnets that she could not sell. Marcus finished the month holding more punnets than his neighbour Bea did. How many punnets does Marcus have?

A city recycling depot receives 224 sacks of cardboard from each of its 6 districts. Every sack holds 9 bundles, each bundle holds 4 packs, and each pack holds 7 flattened sheets. A school then delivered 80 loose sheets to the depot. During the week 188047 sheets were sent on to the paper mill. The depot runs a dozen collection lorries and employs 35 people. How many sheets of cardboard are left at the depot?

A theatre counts its takings in cents and announces them in dollars only at the end of the run. On Monday morning the box office had 137 ticket booklets, and by lunchtime a delivery had made the number of booklets 2 times as large. In the afternoon the printer sent 62 more booklets. Each booklet holds 4 sheets, and every sheet holds 5 tickets. In the evening all of those tickets were sold for 4 cents each at the children's matinee. Dario sold more of them that evening than his colleague Ruth did. How many cents did the theatre take?

On Monday morning a corner shop had 89 loaves of bread on its shelf. Before noon a hostel bought 83 of them. In the early afternoon 5 more loaves were sold to a passer-by. A delivery in the evening put 12 fresh loaves on the same shelf. Just before closing a restaurant took 11 loaves. The shop opens 6 days a week. How many loaves are on the shelf now?

A council depot measures its grit in kilograms although the lorry gauges read in tonnes. The depot began the winter with 156 sacks of grit, and 11 sacks had split open and were thrown away. Each remaining sack was tipped into 4 bins. A neighbouring town then sent 42 more bins of grit. During January 424 bins were emptied onto the roads. Each bin still at the depot holds 6 kilograms of grit, and the depot runs 9 lorries. How many kilograms of grit are at the depot?

On Saturday morning a bakery made 164 cupcakes and shared them equally among its 4 market stalls. Anya took the cupcakes for the stall on the square. At midday the bakery sent her 29 more cupcakes, and in the early afternoon a helper carried over 19 more. In the evening a second bake added 78 cupcakes to Anya's stall. Anya received more cupcakes that day than her colleague Pavel did at his stall. How many cupcakes are on Anya's stall now?

A cinema had 198 tubs of popcorn ready before the evening show, and the kitchen made 7 more. During the film 187 tubs were sold at the counter. A school group then took 8 tubs, and the staff kept 2 tubs for themselves. A dozen film posters hang in the foyer. How many tubs of popcorn are left?
